_meta.source: FIFA. Regulations for the FIFA World Cup 26 (May 2025 edition). Articles 11, 12, 14.

dates.final_venue: MetLife Stadium, East Rutherford, New Jersey, USA

group_stage.matchday_3_rule: The last two matches in each group must have simultaneous kick-off times on the same day (unless force majeure).

qualification_from_groups.rule: Top 2 from each group plus the 8 best third-placed teams advance to the Round of 32.

knockout_stage.extra_time_rules: If level after 90 minutes, 30 minutes of extra time (two 15-min halves with 5-min interval at end of normal time). If still level, penalty shoot-out.
knockout_stage.annex_c_note: Annex C of FIFA regulations contains 495 possible combinations of which 8 third-place teams advance and their R32 opponent. See third_place_matrix_2026.json (TBD).
